commit 351f5fe8c5b3278891441a591613f96519e6cc8e
Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu Aug 21 20:38:41 2025 +0000
Commit:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu Aug 21 20:38:41 2025 +0000

    Bug 1980903 - Fix incorrect .gecko_rev.yml path in verify-pin.sh r=coreycb
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D262024

diff --git a/taskcluster/scripts/verify-pin.sh b/taskcluster/scripts/verify-pin.sh
index 7d37befa45a..f7701e15df7 100755
--- a/taskcluster/scripts/verify-pin.sh
+++ b/taskcluster/scripts/verify-pin.sh
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@ set -xe
 echo "Checking if repo is pinned to an upstream tag..."
 
 # Extract GECKO_HEAD_REF from YAML file
-GECKO_HEAD_REF=$(awk -F': ' '/^GECKO_HEAD_REF:/ {print $2}' ../../.gecko_rev.yml | xargs)
+GECKO_HEAD_REF=$(awk -F': ' '/^GECKO_HEAD_REF:/ {print $2}' comm/.gecko_rev.yml | xargs)
 
 if [[ -z "$GECKO_HEAD_REF" || "$GECKO_HEAD_REF" == "default" ]]; then  # If GECKO_HEAD_REF is not set or is set to 'default'
     echo "GECKO_HEAD_REF is not pinned to a tag or a commit hash; was this on purpose?"
title: Bug 1980903 - Fix incorrect .gecko_rev.yml path in verify-pin.sh r=coreycb
